Second writing prompt for #EDU407Sum19 Writers every where carry a mouth, nose, eyes, ears, tongue, and hand in their toolkits. Draw on sensory writing in our next writing challenge.

Return to a memory, or a previous post, and write with your senses. Show us what you heard, felt, touched, tasted, smelled. Bring us with you, deep inside the writing.
